{'text': "I've noticed that Apple appears to have abandoned Cinematic Mode, and a video test perfectly captures my disappointment.", 'zh-hk': '我最近留意到 Apple 似乎已經放棄咗「電影效果」模式，一段影片測試正好完美展示咗我對此嘅失望。'}

{'text': "My disappointment isn't that the feature is bad — it's that it's so close to being actually usable that it defies explanation why Apple hasn't taken advantage of the massive jump in processing power from the iPhone 13 that first featured it to the latest iPhone. Let me show you...", 'zh-hk': '令我失望嘅唔係呢個功能本身差勁，而係佢已經接近一個實際可用嘅水平，令人難以理解點解 Apple 一直冇好好利用由首次搭載嘅 iPhone 13 去到最新 iPhone 期間處理能力嘅巨大躍升。等我展示畀你睇……'}

{'text': "As I mentioned, I understand why Apple hasn't prioritized updating this feature, but I also feel Apple should update it to encourage a new generation of video creators and filmmakers — particularly teenagers who may not have access to any other filming equipment.", 'zh-hk': '我之前提過，我明白 Apple 點解冇優先更新呢個功能，但同時我亦覺得 Apple 應該更新佢，以鼓勵新一代嘅影片創作者同埋電影製作人——尤其是可能冇其他攝影設備可用嘅青少年。'}

{'text': 'I have a friend who loves approaching strangers on the street for interviews using his smartphone, and he often manages to get them to open up and say the most unexpected things. I decided to turn the tables and put him in the hot seat, again filming with a smartphone, this time the iPhone 16 Pro Max.', 'zh-hk': '我有一位朋友鍾意用智能手機喺街訪問陌生人，佢往往能夠令對方打開心扉，講出最出人意料嘅說話。我決定反轉過嚟，將佢擺喺被訪者嘅位置，同樣以智能手機拍攝，今次我用咗 iPhone 16 Pro Max。'}

{'text': "I wanted to test Cinematic Mode in a relatively simple scenario: a person in the foreground, with railings about 25 feet behind them, and the O2 Arena across the river probably several thousand feet further away. Plus, he'd be sitting on a tall stool, so the amount of movement would be quite limited.", 'zh-hk': '我想喺一個相對簡單嘅場景測試「電影效果」模式：前景有一個人，佢身後大約 25 英尺有欄杆，河流對岸嘅 O2 Arena 估計距離有成幾千英尺遠。此外，佢會坐喺一張高凳上，即係郁動嘅幅度相當有限。'}

{'text': "The result was... so close, yet so far. The overall look was nice, but there was noticeable halation between CK's legs and the railings, and occasionally lost focus when his head moved in front of one of the O2's support pillars; when he stretched out his arms, the river behind him would sometimes come into sharp focus:", 'zh-hk': '結果係……明明好接近，但就差咁一啲。整體觀感唔錯，但 CK 雙腿同欄杆之間有明顯嘅光暈現象，而當佢郁頭部遮住 O2 嘅其中一根柱子時，有時會失焦；當佢伸開雙臂時，佢背後嘅河面間中會變得清晰銳利：'}

{'text': "To be fair, CK felt most people watching the footage wouldn't really notice these issues. Unless they're a filmmaker or a tech enthusiast familiar with how this feature is supposed to work, even if they noticed, they wouldn't see them as a problem. I think he's completely right.", 'zh-hk': '公道啲講，CK 認為大部分睇緊呢段影片嘅觀眾其實唔會真正留意到呢啲問題。如果佢哋唔係電影製作人，又或者唔係熟悉呢個功能運作嘅科技愛好者，就算留意到都唔會覺得有問題。我覺得佢講得完全正確。'}

{'text': "But these flaws really bug me, and I think even amateur movie enthusiasts would share that disappointment — and they're precisely the target audience for this feature.", 'zh-hk': '但呢啲瑕疵真係令我好煩惱，我認為即使是業餘程度嘅電影愛好者都會有同樣嘅失望感——而呢班人正正就係呢個功能嘅目標受眾。'}

{'text': "As I said at the beginning, my disappointment isn't that this is a bad feature — it's that I genuinely believe that if Apple were to put the full power of modern iPhone chipsets and neural processing to work on this, it could be so much better. In fact, I'd expect a truly updated Cinematic Mode to handle scenarios far more complex than this.", 'zh-hk': '正如我一開始所講，我失望嘅唔係呢個功能差勁，而係我真心相信，如果 Apple 能夠好好善用現時 iPhone 晶片嘅強大運算能力同神經網絡處理效能，呢個功能絕對可以大幅提升。事實上，我期望一個真正更新過嘅「電影效果」模式能夠處理比呢個複雜得多嘅拍攝環境。'}

{'text': 'Do you agree? Would you like to see Apple pay some attention to Cinematic Mode? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.', 'zh-hk': '你同意我嘅睇法嗎？你想唔想見到 Apple 關注一下「電影效果」模式？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅意見。'}
